Research · New Energy Nexus Ventures
SEA Climate Disruptions 2026

The State of the Industry research I built at New Energy Nexus Ventures: why Southeast Asia is the next climate-solutions frontier. Up to 11% of regional GDP is at risk by 2100 with ~US$100B already absorbed in annual climate damages — against an US$8T green-economy market cap and multi-trillion-dollar funding gaps. The report maps the full solutions stack (mitigation, adaptation & resilience, and the AI/MRV software backbone) across the region’s integrated laboratory: Singapore’s capital, Indonesia’s demand, Vietnam’s manufacturing, the Philippines’ resilience. Hit ► Pitch for the narrated walkthrough.

Research · Living Lab Ventures
Mid‑Year 2025 VC Outlook
Full report ↗

The research publication I co-authored at Living Lab Ventures, mapping what comes after a bruising start to 2025 — deal value down 59% across Southeast Asia and 85% in Indonesia from Q4 2024 to Q1 2025, a low not seen since 2022. Inside: healthcare’s climb to the region’s second most-funded sector, manufacturing & nearshoring momentum as global trade reroutes, and the investment windows opened by Prabowo’s economic agenda. Presented by our Partner Bayu Seto; co-authored with Sari Ichtiari and Fadhlan Fariz. Hit ► Pitch for the narrated walkthrough.
